# `aitbc agent-msg receive`

Receive messages from the Agent Coordinator inbox for the configured agent.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-msg receive [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--from-agent` | text | — | no | Agent ID whose inbox to read (default: $AGENT_ID) |
| `--limit` | integer | `20` | no | Number of messages to return |
| `--unread-only` | flag | `false` | no | Only return unread messages |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet signing the inbox request headers (default: $AITBC_DEFAULT_WALLET) |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--sign`, `--no-sign` | flag | `true` | no | Sign the request when a wallet is configured |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Agent Coordinator URL (default: from config) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-msg receive
```
